packet_ingest.unique_open_question_resolved: VoiceSessionCapsule per-response conditioning versus merely constructed/refreshed capsule state

semantic_atoms.claim: The current stern.py PreToolUse 'zulassen' path evaluates capability, generation, preconditions and same-session verified repetition and writes an effects row, but it does not block execution. ABGELEHNT/WIEDERHOLUNG/UNGEPRUEFT are journal findings; source commentary explicitly states that PreToolUse returns no deny/block and that the tool runs even on doubt, timeout or error. PostToolUse then hashes/records the observed outcome through merken().
semantic_atoms.authority: journal/assessment and post-effect observation only; this span is not a deterministic blocking EffectGate
semantic_atoms.failure_behavior: admission exceptions fail silent; best-effort UNGEPRUEFT can be written, otherwise the tool still runs
known_counterevidence: Source comments mention an older separate blocking watcher outside this stern.py path. That separate mechanism was not mapped in this run and cannot be used to upgrade stern.py itself into a blocking gate.
semantic_atoms.grid10_adaptation: Preserve the useful request/result journal, generation checks, redaction and outcome hashing, but put real state-changing execution behind one source-bound deterministic EffectGate/EffectJournal authority. A rejected or unknown admission must not execute merely because the observer is fail-silent.
open_questions: Map cmd_hook's exact PreToolUse/PostToolUse dispatch plus any external blocking watcher before Triggerword-4 assembly.
Define UNKNOWN external-effect outcome semantics so transport ambiguity is never blindly replayed.

semantic_atoms.claim: RealtimeSession constructs and repeatedly refreshes VoiceSessionCapsule from presence, visual state, winning intent, memory refs, policy and related state, but _response_erstellen() creates each normal model response from _instruktion(self._zustandstext) plus an optional hint only. No capsule serialization or capsule-derived context compiler is present in that per-response instruction path. Therefore the capsule is a real refreshed projection, but as a whole it is not yet direct per-response model conditioning.
semantic_atoms.authority: VoiceSessionCapsule remains RAM projection only; it has no canonical state authority
known_counterevidence: Some underlying state can still affect voice indirectly through _zustandstext, explicit arbitration, deictic re-look and initiative hints. This finding is specifically about the capsule projection not being compiled into every response, not about total absence of state coupling.
semantic_atoms.grid10_adaptation: Add one deterministic bounded Voice/GRID context compiler that selects provenance-bearing capsule/GRID fields for response conditioning. Keep the capsule noncanonical, preserve UNKNOWN, respect privacy/output tiers, and emit a conditioning receipt or digest so state->response coupling is measurable rather than assumed.
open_questions: Which capsule fields are necessary for ordinary replies versus initiative-only arbitration?
How should context compilation enforce token budget, freshness, privacy tier, provenance and conflict preservation without copying UnifiedDB into the prompt?
Add a lesion/shuffle test: same transcript with capsule field removed or permuted must produce the preregistered measurable decision delta only where that field is causally intended.

contradictions.resolution: stern.py's current EffectGate-named admission is conclusively nonblocking at source level; retain its journal value but do not treat it as final 2.0 effect authority. Separate external blocker remains to be mapped.
VoiceSessionCapsule construction/refresh is real, while direct per-response capsule conditioning is absent from _response_erstellen(); 2.0 needs an explicit bounded context-compiler edge.

hypotheses: The donor effect journal can survive largely intact if execution authority is moved in front of the real effect boundary instead of trying to reinterpret journal statuses as enforcement.

Voice coupling will become measurably stronger and less prompt-fragile if a small typed context compiler serializes only the winning/current capsule slice rather than expanding the static persona or dumping full state.
counterhypotheses: A separate existing blocking watcher may already provide part of the real effect gate; if exact current source and call ordering prove that, 2.0 should fuse it rather than build a duplicate blocker.
Injecting the entire VoiceSessionCapsule every turn could increase latency/context contamination without causal benefit; field-level lesion tests should determine the minimal conditioning slice.
next_exact_gate: Map stern.py cmd_hook plus any separate blocking watcher into one request->admission->execution->verification graph, then specify/test the minimal provenance-bearing VoiceSessionCapsule/GRID context compiler with lesion/shuffle controls.
